metadata.name: Ecodesign for Astro
metadata.description: Ecodesign rules for Astro: static by default, the smallest client directive, media optimised at build.

hydratation.name: Astro — hydration
hydratation.description: Every hydrated island ships a runtime the static page did not need (RGESN Frontend).

rules.title: Island hydrated on load
rules.description: client:load ships and boots the component's framework before the user has done anything. On a component below the fold, that runtime is downloaded, parsed and executed for an interaction that may never happen.
rules.recommendation: Pick the smallest directive that meets the interaction: client:idle, client:visible, or client:media. Keep client:load for what must be interactive immediately.
rules.source_note: Adapted from the Green Codex rule LANG-ASTRO-003 (Institut du Numerique Responsable), whose rule content is published under CC BY 4.0. Reworded for this format; the patterns are specific to this audit.

rules.title: Image used without the build-time pipeline
rules.description: A raw img tag skips the optimisation Astro would have done at build: no modern format, no responsive sizes, no dimensions. The visitor pays the difference on every load.
rules.recommendation: Use the Image component so the format, the sizes and the dimensions are produced at build time, and keep an accessible alt.
rules.note: Importing the Image component anywhere in the file silences the rule. A raw img is legitimate for an SVG or a remote asset the build cannot process, so check what the source points at.
rules.source_note: Adapted from the Green Codex rule LANG-ASTRO-002 (Institut du Numerique Responsable), whose rule content is published under CC BY 4.0. Reworded for this format; the patterns are specific to this audit.
